name: Qualiaffordance
original_name: クオリアフォーダンス
source:
Kazuki is your typical shy boy who couldn’t turn down a request nor doubt others. However, after one summer vacation incident, he became able to see the ‘colours’ of other people’s emotions. Something deep in his heart warned him not to look at it. However, as he became closer to the heroines, the ordinary becomes the extraordinary.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一树是个典型的腼腆男孩，既不懂得拒绝别人的请求，也不会怀疑他人。然而，某个暑假发生的一起事件，使他获得了看见他人感情“颜色”的能力。他内心深处的某种声音警告他不要窥视这些颜色。可是，随着他与女主角们越发亲近，平凡的日常逐渐变得非同寻常。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
